import numpy as np
sites = np.array([[216.0, 7155.0, 0.45], [235.0, 7669.0, 0.55], [182.0, 22175.0, 0.62]])
def twice_model(s, i, p, t, r):
    s2 = np.array(s, dtype=float)
    apply_break(s2, i, p, t, r)
    return np.asarray(apply_break(s2, i, p, t, r), dtype=float)
assert np.allclose(twice_model(sites, 1, 'hom', 0.045, 0.06), target)
